title: SK Chairman Chey says chip demand to keep growing fast
key_facts: SK Chairman Chey Tae-won spoke on Friday 9 Oct 2026 in Seoul.
He was visiting the site of a new semiconductor hub for SK hynix in South Korea.
He said chip demand is expected to keep growing at a fast pace.
No figures were given in the wire text.
quote_evidence: SEOUL, Oct 9 (Reuters) - SK Chairman Chey Tae-won said on Friday during a visit to the site of a new semiconductor hub for SK Hynix in South Korea that demand for chips is expected to keep growing at a fast pace.
why_it_matters_hint: Executive confidence in continued chip demand; no figures.
notes: Reuters page returned 401; the short wire text was read in a copy on Central Oregon Daily, which carries Reuters (Joyce Lee and Hyunjoo Jin reporting). The wire is one paragraph.
